FN-967RMMB-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 110
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 110 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Medical
Examiners and the Medical Licensure Commission until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the
Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
